provider_local.title: Local media
provider_local.intro: Your own songs and films, from folders on the device and their subfolders. Put files there from the Media page, or point it at a folder or a mounted drive.
provider_local.paths.hint: Empty: the user's Music and Videos folders.
provider_local.min_confidence: How closely a file must match
provider_local.min_confidence.hint: Files that match less than this are left out.
